title: MSHvSF-derived Capcom Saturn porting pattern library
promotion_rule: A research method may be reusable after deterministic proof. A claimed Capcom engineering practice remains a candidate until runtime evidence and a second official port confirm it.

patterns.problem: Authorized source media may have loader-layout defects, and repairing it in place destroys provenance.
patterns.official_capcom_solution: Not applicable; this is a modern research-control pattern.
patterns.implementation_pattern: Hash immutable inputs and build disposable MAME ROM-path and Saturn cue overlays for audit and boot.
constraints: Never rewrite source archives, cue, BIN, or keys
Hash the overlay recipe and source inputs

patterns.problem: AI decisions contaminate collision, damage, and hit-reaction timing.
patterns.official_capcom_solution: Not applicable; this is a test-construction pattern.
patterns.hardware_rationale: Removes nondeterministic decision paths from cross-platform evidence.
patterns.implementation_pattern: Use two human controller ports, hold the target neutral after setup, and record every input byte.
constraints: Prove P2 is neutral during gameplay
Use the same matchup and spacing
applicable_game_types: Cooperative action games with a controllable test target

patterns.problem: 68000 and SH-2 machine code are not directly comparable and visual similarity can hide mechanical differences.
patterns.official_capcom_solution: Not applicable; this is a comparative-analysis pattern.
patterns.hardware_rationale: Separates behavior from processor and renderer implementation.
patterns.implementation_pattern: Pair semantic events first, then require state, timing, data, and falsification evidence before classifying mechanics.
constraints: Keep gameplay and presentation timing separate

patterns.problem: A CD game must divide music, speech, and short effects across disc and sound hardware.
patterns.official_capcom_solution: The MSHvSF disc contains eleven CD audio tracks and 71 ADP files.
patterns.hardware_rationale: Candidate division between streamed music and file-loaded audio; event routing is not traced.
constraints: Do not infer ADP content from names alone
Trace CDDA and SCSP behavior before reuse
applicable_game_types: CD-based arcade conversions with music and many short voice/effect assets

patterns.problem: Large rosters and stages require independently loadable asset groups.
patterns.official_capcom_solution: The flat ISO exposes distinct PLxx, BGxx, SOxx, PAC, ADP, and ST2 naming families.
patterns.hardware_rationale: Individually addressable files could support phase loading, but destination and lifetime are not traced.
constraints: File naming is not format proof
On-disc size is not resident size
Confirm load calls and allocation lifetime

patterns.problem: The Saturn base-memory working set may not hold a large CPS-2 fighter roster and effects.
patterns.official_capcom_solution: The official port boots and replays with a configured 32 Mbit DRAM cartridge.
patterns.hardware_rationale: An additional 4 MiB is available, but allocation and residency are untraced.
constraints: Successful configuration does not prove exact requirement or layout
Measure cartridge writes and no-cart behavior
applicable_game_types: Ports with high animation working sets
